purpose: Serial optimization pass log for the CoSyn-v16.0.0 build. Records candidate optimizations, evaluation against material-net-positive criteria, and convergence.
material_net_positive_criteria: does not introduce new authority overlap

candidates.candidate: Merge canonical-manifest-v16.0.0.json into core-package-manifest-v16.0.0.json to reduce manifest count.
candidates.evaluation: Canonical manifest is a lightweight semantic index (filename+role). Package manifest is the extension-contract-conformant full manifest with capabilities and dependencies. Separation-of-concerns supports distinct consumers (subordinate-spec index vs composition-time validator). Merging would blur roles and reduce clarity.
Same separation-of-concerns argument. Integrity manifest is machine-checkable hash-verification; canonical manifest is semantic index. Merging would couple two orthogonal validation concerns.

candidates.candidate: Edit interior content of copied CfW files to replace legacy CfW/CGS references with v16 references.
candidates.evaluation: Would violate the deterministic 'preserve interior content verbatim' pattern documented in migration-provenance-map. The v16 authority header prepend explicitly supersedes interior legacy references for composition purposes; interior legacy references are historical (source-basis fidelity). Content edits would introduce a large defect surface and compound derivation errors.

candidates.candidate: Split writing-editing-critique-preservation-conversion-v16.0.0.md into four artifacts (one per phase).
candidates.evaluation: Source ships as a single artifact and internal cross-references are integrated. Splitting would introduce new coupling (four new inter-file references) without governance benefit. The single artifact's activation model is phase-conditional per activation rules, which handles selective activation without file split.

candidates.candidate: Add structured applicability_predicate field to CW bolt-on manifest for machine-checkable applicability instead of human-readable sentence.
candidates.evaluation: CoSyn v16 in-chat governance is interpreted (not executable). Machine predicates would imply an executable enforcement layer that the Constitution §19 Non-Runtime Statement explicitly disclaims. Scope creep beyond approved architecture.

candidates.candidate: Expand the grouped provenance entry for copied CfW files into individual per-file entries.
candidates.evaluation: Group entry names every affected file explicitly plus notes shared treatment. Source-classification-map already provides per-file source_basis. Splitting into individual entries would duplicate identical semantic-change text 15+ times without adding traceability. No material gain.

candidates.candidate: PTR Specification §20 needs an explicit note that bolt-on PCR extensions must declare Core dependency and cannot restate promotion ratification rules.
candidates.evaluation: Already present in ptr-specification-v16.0.0.md §20 last paragraph and §21.9. Confirmed in Phase 8 semantic sync.

candidates.candidate: Persona Governor needs an explicit Package-Composition Gate section referencing extension contract §5.
candidates.evaluation: Already present as persona-governor-v16.0.0.md §12. Confirmed in Phase 5 derivation.

candidates.candidate: Stack Architect needs Package-Composition Routing sub-route.
candidates.evaluation: Already present as stack-architect-v16.0.0.md §6 (Package-composition routing) and §9 (Deployment Hardening Routing / Package-Composition Routing).

candidates.candidate: Constitution §7 Class 0 list needs 'silent composition of governance packages when duplicate ownership / unauthorized extension / cross-bolt-on conflict is present.'
candidates.evaluation: Already present as the final entry in cosyn-constitution-v16.0.0.md §7 Class 0 Failures.

candidates.candidate: Defer Tier-2 binding position enforcement to bolt-on load time rather than composition-time.
candidates.evaluation: Extension contract §4 step 2 explicitly enforces Tier-2 binding at composition time. Deferring would weaken fail-closed behavior. Rejected as governance-weakening.

candidates.candidate: Add an explicit cross-reference table between extension-contract §5 categories and adversarial-test-report tests.
candidates.evaluation: adversarial-test-report already lists each test's 'category' field aligned to §5 categories, plus a test_summary.categories_covered enumeration and test_summary.all_extension_contract_5_categories_covered = true assertion. Adequate coverage transparency. No material gain.

passes.pass_conclusion: No material net-positive changes identified after serial review of the complete generated architecture across governance redundancy, authority clarity, capability boundaries, provenance completeness, validation coverage, semantic synchronization, deterministic composition, and context efficiency.
Pass 1 applied no changes; Pass 2 operates against identical state. No new opportunities. Convergence.

no unnecessary context weight beyond substantive governance semantics
no stale semantic references (all v15 references confined to §0 Provenance blocks that legitimately cite source basis)
no unnecessary cross-package coupling (each bolt-on extension declares single Core dependency)
no weak applicability boundaries (CW bolt-on applicability_declaration + fail-closed wrong-context load)
no weak fail-closed behavior (all 12 extension-contract §5 categories enumerated and structurally enforced)
no naming/version inconsistencies (Phase 8 semantic sync confirmed)
no provenance gaps (migration-provenance-map covers every derived artifact)
no unneeded legacy residue (all legacy dup-of-Core artifacts excluded; interior legacy references in copied files documented as historical + superseded by v16 authority header)
no duplicated explanatory text carrying governing semantics
no missing validation coverage (20 adversarial tests + 6 structural validations)
notes: Optimization loop reaches no-gain convergence after Pass 1. Pass 2 confirms.
Serial-only execution constraint honored throughout: no subagents, no parallel processing, no concurrent workers.

Compute conservation was applied after accuracy protection: source reads were serialized in lex order; derivation used preservation-plus-modification (CGS Editing Discipline §Core Rule) so writing-team-personas and bookfox reference retain source content byte-substantively.
No composition-time defect, semantic-desynchronization defect, hash-mismatch defect, missing-provenance defect, or unauthorized-extension defect detected across Core and CW bolt-on.
